test_title: PYST 8 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In the following question, in each option a pair of figures is given. In each pair the figure towards the left of (:) is related by some logic/rule/relation with the figure on the right of (:). Select the odd figure pair from the given alternatives.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The number of **lines on the right** corresponds to the **number of sides of the polygon on the left**.

Option 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a7edae42da57b0ee9af698d65786a308debf6a665416aed9b3c76afc1f997c9.png] 

Triangle → 3 sides → 3 lines on the right 

Option 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e15e6656af8f33402e427f6ba6340e5713adb505432e56a81ab49892c107b5a9.png] 

Pentagon → 5 sides → 5 lines on the right 

Option 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f1ea4801df6a0e5f4084d3cf883b48a384db6729e8579e0bd6f2b060dded3ae.png] 

Rectangle → 4 sides → 4 lines on the right 

Option 4:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04b96f158e01aaabc93410d95f6a6b71bfa99e02961765cda867aa941dd31986.png] 

**Rectangle → 4 sides → 5 lines on the right **

Hence, the odd pair is **Option 4**.
